definitions.gloss: ardent desire; fervent wish; burning aspiration
definitions.explanation: An intense, passionate desire for something. Stronger than {希望|きぼう} (hope) or {願望|がんぼう} (wish), conveying urgency and emotional intensity.

examples.japanese: {平和|へいわ}を{熱望|ねつぼう}する。
ファンが{続編|ぞくへん}を{熱望|ねつぼう}している。
examples.english: Fans are eagerly hoping for a sequel.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{熱望|ねつぼう}していた{海外|かいがい}{留学|りゅうがく}がついに{実現|じつげん}した。
examples.english: The study abroad that I had fervently wished for over many years finally came true.

notes:
Composed of {熱|ねつ} (heat, passion) + {望|ぼう} (desire, hope). Conveys intense, burning desire — stronger than ordinary wanting.

INTENSITY SCALE:
- {希望|きぼう}: hope, wish (mild)
- {願望|がんぼう}: desire, wish (moderate)
- {熱望|ねつぼう}: ardent desire, fervent wish (strong)
- {渇望|かつぼう}: craving, desperate longing (strongest)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱望|ねつぼう}する: to ardently desire
- {熱望|ねつぼう}されている: to be eagerly awaited
- {長年|ながねん}の{熱望|ねつぼう}: long-held ardent wish
- ファンが{熱望|ねつぼう}: fans eagerly hope for

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Common in news, essays, and formal speech. In casual conversation, すごく{欲|ほ}しい or {待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む is more natural.
